text: MISSING A PIECE. I SLIPPED AWAY. IT’S ALL PART OF MY PLAN. I’M REALLY HERE TO KILL THE DEMON MOTHER LADY AND HER JERK SON, WHO I THOUGHT WAS MY FRIEND BUT HE TRICKED ME INTO GIVING BIRTH TO A MONSTER THAT WILL DESTROY ALL OF CREATION BOTH INSIDE AND OUTSIDE THE DUNGEON. DOESN’T THAT SOUND FUN? WHY ARE YOU HERE? AND WHAT ARE YOU WEARING? The End HERE WE ARE YET AGAIN. It is March 24, 2026. Hours ago, I stepped off a very long flight from Edinburgh where Jeff Hays, Maude Garrett, and I just wrapped our very first UK book tour. Every single stop was sold out. It was amazing, exhilarating, and overwhelming. I have less than 24 hours before I have to get on another flight to New Zealand for my event there. Then I’m off to NYC again. Then Denver. Then another full-blown tour. Everything is different now. Writing something that you know will be read by literally thousands of people is goddamned terrifying. Without naming names, I understand now how some people can get…clogged. Luckily for me, I still love this so very much. My mind is always in the dungeon. I’m already hard at work for Dungeon Crawler Carl’s penultimate book, and I don’t want it to end. As they say, once you enter the dungeon… Thank you, everyone, for changing my life.
